differences.native: The verified MySQL query uses DATE_ADD(first_login, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and MySQL division.
differences.app: The offline SQLite query uses date(first_login, '+1 day') and multiplies the numerator by 1.0 to prevent integer division.
differences.rationale: These are the respective dialect-native spellings of the same next-calendar-day join and fractional aggregation. The CTE, grouping, join keys, numerator, denominator, rounding, result schema, and complexity are unchanged.
